column1: # Skill provenance manifest — the single source of truth for scripts/check-skill-updates.sh.
# When you add, remove, re-sync, or locally edit a skill, update this file first,
# then refresh the tables in ../README.md to match.
#   local_dir      directory name under the skills root (~/.pi/agent/skills)
#   source         upstream GitHub repo as owner/name, or "-" when authored here
#   upstream_path  path of the skill directory inside that repo
#   pinned_sha     upstream commit this copy was last compared against
#   local_state    verbatim   = byte-identical to the upstream tree at pinned_sha
#                  modified   = local edits on top of upstream
#                  divergent  = related to upstream but the body was rewritten here
#   notes          short free-text note; do not use tabs. "-" means none.

column6: local variant; frontmatter credits addyosmani, body rewritten
